Albert Park — circuit survey

Australian GP · Australia · theme green / park · day · build 6508220 (branch cursor/survey-albert_park-a1) · surveyed 2026-10-15 · read-only (no js/css edits) · 68 frames embedded

Legend: measured = produced by a tool in this session; source = claim from the brief / def comments / docs, not verified; guess = my inference. Browser frames: harness Chromium, SwiftShader, TLX backend, 844×390, HUD hidden. Day rows (dry/overcast/fog/wet/rain/storm) were re-shot with shot.mjs --weather on a tree merged with origin/cursor/overcast-sky-fix-a1 (sky fix, wet lighting #1979, camera clearing); dusk, night and the cockpit row are the earlier shots from the pre-merge tree (custom harness, HUD toast and HELMET button visible, orbit not tree-cleared).

1 · Summary

  • Geometry and audits are clean: verify OK, 0 floating, 0 coplanar, 0 unsupported; one severe clip (3.40 m, baseline-accepted) at frac 0.784 that I traced to bowlSeatWall on the inside of a ~18 m radius corner.
  • The weak points are visual, not structural: green “mountains” on a flat lakeside park, conifer-shaped trees against a eucalyptus brief, and, before the sky fix, weather that barely changed the daytime sky (re-shot after the fix: grey overcast/fog, dark wet rain/storm).
  • Night is floodlit and readable but the lake and CBD towers are unlit dark blocks.

6 · Gallery — weather × time of day × lap position

Orbit camera (az 35°, el 22°, 45 m) around the player at each frac, car at 30 m/s after jump(); one page per time of day, weather switched with __apex.weather() + setTimeOfDay() in-page, so the first frame of a row follows a switch. Images ≤800 px wide JPEG.

DAY · dry · orbit 6/6

AFTER SKY FIX build (merged overcast-sky-fix-a1), shot.mjs. Reference row. Saturated blue sky, green ridges (defect 1), conifer-shaped trees (defect 2); camera now clears trees.

DAY · overcast · orbit 6/6

AFTER SKY FIX: sky is now a flat grey zenith and the scene is softer; far ridges still read as green hills.

DAY · fog · orbit 6/6

AFTER SKY FIX: grey sky plus real distance haze (far ridges and lake fade); local ground haze near trees remains.

DAY · wet · orbit 6/6

AFTER wet-lighting merge: wet sheen and darker tarmac; sky grey rather than blue.

DAY · rain · orbit 6/6

AFTER merge: dark grey sky, wet reflective ground (tree reflections visible), crowns look semi-transparent/ghosted against the reflections; frame 0.67 shows the field.

DAY · storm · orbit 6/6

NEW (storm, after merge): near-black ridges under a dark grey sky, strongest reflections, streaks visible. Reads as storm, not night. Ghosted crowns as in rain.

DUSK · dry · orbit 6/6

Sky response is good: purple/orange gradient. Warm floodlight pools on the road. The 0.33 frame has a heavy yellow bloom wash across the right-hand trees.

DUSK · rain · orbit 6/6

Rain at dusk gives a darker navy sky (weather does reach the sky here, unlike day). Wet sheen at S/F; floodlight pools unchanged.

NIGHT · dry · orbit 6/6

Floodlit pools along the road; sky and lake pure black; green ridges stay bright against the black sky; CBD towers (0.50/0.67) are dark blocks with no window lights.

NIGHT · rain · orbit 6/6

As night dry with a reflective stripe at S/F; rain streaks barely visible; no lit skyline. Hills and trees remain saturated green at night.

DAWN · dry · orbit 2/6

PARTIAL: only the frames listed were captured before the capture time limit; the rest of the dawn row was cut.

DAY · dry · cockpit/eye 6/6

Cockpit/eye view at the same fracs. Confirms the conifer-shaped crowns (0.17, 0.50, 0.83), the saturated blue sky, a very flat open road, and dark CBD tower silhouettes over the trees (0.33, 0.50). Wheel/halo overlay is the car, not scenery.

Real-world cross-check

Only the brief’s own cited sources (Wikipedia, F1 circuit guide 2026, Piastri stand) were consulted via the brief; I did no fresh web research this session. Brief claims: 5.278 km, 14 corners, anticlockwise, essentially flat, Lakeside Drive concrete barriers. Estimates in the brief (CBD tower bearings, Piastri bay length ~72 m) stay estimates. The 5261 m built length is within 0.32 % of 5278 m.

Not run: graph-parity (no scenery-graph migration in scope), flicker/motion capture, per-prop ground profile.
